courses.title: Introduction to LearnPress: Building Your Learning Management System
courses.excerpt: Learn the essential steps for creating and launching an online learning site with LearnPress.
courses.content: This introductory course explains how LearnPress organizes courses, lessons, students, and learning settings. Follow the lessons to prepare a practical LMS foundation that can grow with your academy.

section.title: LearnPress Foundations
section.description: A guided introduction to planning, configuring, and publishing a LearnPress LMS.

lessons.title: Define Your LMS Goals
lessons.content: Identify your learners, the skills they need, and the result each course should deliver. Clear goals help you choose the right course structure and content.

lessons.title: Install and Configure LearnPress
lessons.content: Review the core settings, required pages, currency, and email options that prepare LearnPress for everyday use.

lessons.title: Understand Courses, Sections, and Lessons
lessons.content: Learn how a course contains sections and how each section groups lessons into a clear learning path.

lessons.title: Prepare the Student Experience
lessons.content: Check course presentation, enrollment behavior, navigation, and the profile area from a student's point of view.

lessons.title: Publish Your First Learning Path
lessons.content: Review the curriculum, confirm visibility, and publish a simple course that students can start using.

courses.title: Create and Manage Engaging LMS Websites with LearnPress
courses.excerpt: Build a well-organized learning website and keep students engaged throughout their courses.
courses.content: This course focuses on planning an engaging academy, organizing useful content, and maintaining a consistent experience for students and instructors.

section.title: Build an Engaging Academy
section.description: Practical lessons for designing, operating, and improving a LearnPress website.

lessons.title: Plan the Learning Website
lessons.content: Map the academy's audience, course topics, navigation, and calls to action before creating content.

lessons.title: Structure Course Content Clearly
lessons.content: Break a topic into focused lessons and arrange them in an order that is easy for students to follow.

lessons.title: Encourage Student Engagement
lessons.content: Use clear outcomes, practical activities, progress cues, and useful feedback to keep learners involved.

lessons.title: Manage Courses and Learners
lessons.content: Review enrollment, student progress, instructor responsibilities, and routine course updates.

lessons.title: Improve the Academy Over Time
lessons.content: Collect feedback, refresh outdated lessons, and simplify areas where learners commonly lose momentum.

courses.title: How To Sell In-Person Courses With LearnPress
courses.excerpt: Use LearnPress to present, sell, and manage instructor-led classes held at a physical location.
courses.content: This course shows how to package an in-person class as a LearnPress course, communicate logistics, collect registrations, and manage the learner journey.

section.title: Launch an In-Person Course
section.description: Set up the offer, schedule, payments, enrollment, and delivery workflow.

lessons.title: Design the In-Person Offer
lessons.content: Define the class outcome, audience, delivery format, capacity, and prerequisites before publishing the offer.

lessons.title: Add Schedule and Location Details
lessons.content: Provide dates, session times, venue information, access instructions, and a clear cancellation policy.

lessons.title: Configure Pricing and Payment
lessons.content: Choose a price, configure an available payment gateway, and explain what the registration fee includes.

lessons.title: Manage Enrollment and Communication
lessons.content: Track registrations and send learners the confirmation, preparation details, and reminders they need.

lessons.title: Deliver and Follow Up
lessons.content: Prepare attendance, learning materials, post-class resources, and a simple follow-up process.

courses.title: Create an LMS Website with LearnPress
courses.excerpt: Follow a practical path from a new WordPress site to a working online academy.
courses.content: This course walks through the main decisions and setup tasks required to turn a WordPress website into a usable LearnPress learning platform.

section.title: From Website to LMS
section.description: Build the site foundation, configure LearnPress, create a course, and prepare for launch.

lessons.title: Prepare WordPress for Your Academy
lessons.content: Choose a clear site structure, confirm the basic WordPress settings, and prepare the pages learners will use.

lessons.title: Install LearnPress and Run Setup
lessons.content: Install the plugin and complete the initial setup for learning experience, pages, payments, and emails.

lessons.title: Configure Core LMS Settings
lessons.content: Review course behavior, profile access, checkout, currency, and notification settings before adding content.

lessons.title: Create and Review a Course
lessons.content: Add a course, organize its curriculum, preview the student experience, and correct missing information.

lessons.title: Launch and Extend the Website
lessons.content: Publish the academy, test enrollment, and evaluate optional extensions only when the learning workflow requires them.

courses.title: Introduction LearnPress – LMS Plugin
courses.excerpt: Explore the core LearnPress concepts used to create and manage online courses in WordPress.
courses.content: This beginner-friendly course introduces the LearnPress workflow and the main tools used by administrators, instructors, and students.

section.title: LearnPress Essentials
section.description: Understand the plugin, build a curriculum, and prepare a simple course for learners.

lessons.title: What LearnPress Provides
lessons.content: Explore the roles of courses, lessons, students, instructors, orders, and settings within a LearnPress academy.

lessons.title: Navigate the LearnPress Dashboard
lessons.content: Locate the main administration screens and understand where course content and global behavior are managed.

lessons.title: Build a Simple Curriculum
lessons.content: Create a course section and add focused lessons that guide learners toward a specific outcome.

lessons.title: Configure Enrollment and Access
lessons.content: Review free and paid enrollment paths, profile access, and the settings that control how students begin learning.

lessons.title: Review, Publish, and Maintain
lessons.content: Check course details, publish the content, monitor learner use, and update lessons as the topic changes.
